_help: Each checkpoint is one part of the written method. 'sentences' is the model answer (also used for the ordering exercise). 'cloze' is the same text with [[answer|other accepted answer]] gaps. A marking point is met when ONE sentence of the learner's text contains a word from EVERY group in 'keywords'. Words match at the start of a word, so 'rins' matches rinse, rinsed, rinsing.

checkpoints.title: Preparing the burette
checkpoints.prompt: Describe how you prepared and filled the burette.
sentences: Rinse the burette with distilled water, then with a little of the acid.
Clamp the burette vertically and fill it with the acid using a funnel.
Remove the funnel.
Open the tap to run some acid through so the jet is full and has no air bubbles.
Read the initial level at eye level, at the bottom of the meniscus.
cloze: Rinse the burette with distilled water, then with a little of the [[acid|hydrochloric acid|sulfuric acid]].
Clamp the burette [[vertically|upright]] and fill it with the acid using a funnel.
[[Remove|Take out]] the funnel.
Open the tap to run some acid through so the [[jet|tip]] is full and has no air bubbles.
Read the initial level at [[eye level|eye-level]], at the bottom of the meniscus.

points.text: Rinse the burette with the acid
Fill the burette using a funnel
Fill the jet so there are no air bubbles

checkpoints.title: Measuring the alkali
checkpoints.prompt: Describe how you measured exactly 25.0 cm³ of the alkali into the flask.
sentences: Rinse the pipette with a little of the alkali.
Using a pipette filler, draw the alkali up until the bottom of the meniscus is on the mark.
Transfer 25.0 cm³ of the alkali into a conical flask that has been rinsed with distilled water.
Let the pipette drain and touch the tip on the surface; do not blow out the last drop.
cloze: Rinse the pipette with a little of the [[alkali|sodium hydroxide|sodium carbonate]].
Using a pipette [[filler|bulb]], draw the alkali up until the bottom of the meniscus is on the [[mark|line]].
Transfer [[25.0|25]] cm³ of the alkali into a conical flask that has been rinsed with [[distilled water|water]].
Let the pipette drain and touch the tip on the surface; do not [[blow]] out the last drop.

points.text: Rinse the pipette with the alkali
Fill to the mark (bottom of the meniscus)
Transfer 25.0 cm³ into a conical flask
The flask is rinsed with distilled water only

checkpoints.title: Adding the indicator
checkpoints.prompt: Describe how you added the indicator and set up the flask.
sentences: Add two or three drops of a suitable indicator, such as phenolphthalein, to the alkali in the flask.
Place the flask on a white tile so the colour change is easy to see.
cloze: Add two or three [[drops|drop]] of a suitable indicator, such as [[phenolphthalein|methyl orange]], to the alkali in the flask.
Place the flask on a [[white tile|white paper|tile]] so the colour change is easy to see.

points.text: Add a few drops of indicator
Stand the flask on a white tile

checkpoints.title: Titrating
checkpoints.prompt: Describe how you carried out the titration.
sentences: Add the acid from the burette to the flask while swirling the flask.
Near the end point, add the acid drop by drop.
Stop when the indicator just changes colour permanently, for example pink to colourless for phenolphthalein.
cloze: Add the acid from the burette to the flask while [[swirling|shaking|mixing]] the flask.
Near the [[end point|end-point]], add the acid drop by drop.
Stop when the indicator just changes colour [[permanently|for good]], for example pink to colourless for phenolphthalein.

points.text: Add dropwise near the end point
Stop at the first permanent colour change

checkpoints.title: Reading and recording
checkpoints.prompt: Describe how you read the burette and recorded your results.
sentences: Read the burette at eye level, at the bottom of the meniscus.
Record the initial and final readings to two decimal places, to the nearest 0.05 cm³.
The titre is the final reading minus the initial reading.
cloze: Read the burette at [[eye level|eye-level]], at the [[bottom|base]] of the meniscus.
Record the initial and final readings to [[two|2]] decimal places, to the nearest [[0.05]] cm³.
The titre is the final reading [[minus|subtract]] the initial reading.

points.text: Read the bottom of the meniscus

checkpoints.title: Repeating to concordance
checkpoints.prompt: Describe how you made sure your result was reliable.
sentences: Do a rough titration first to find the approximate end point.
Repeat the titration accurately until at least two titres are concordant, agreeing within 0.10 cm³.
Calculate the mean of the concordant titres only.
cloze: Do a [[rough|trial]] titration first to find the approximate end point.
Repeat the titration accurately until at least two titres are [[concordant|consistent]], agreeing within [[0.10|0.1]] cm³.
Calculate the [[mean|average]] of the concordant titres only.
